## Creation, authority and state (L1, P1, P2, P7)

Use L1 model (a): a versioned server recommendation is PROPOSED for a reviewed FindingRevision; an Action is created **on acceptance**, so Action has no PROPOSED state. Recommendation key is `(tenant_id,site_id,finding_revision_id,foundation_revision_id,rule_id,rule_version,asset_id)`; server acceptance key is a canonical digest of that tuple plus `ACCEPT`, unique within tenant/Site. The pinned FoundationRevision ID is also in the acceptance payload digest. Identical accept returns the same Action/event; same key with altered payload is 409. Allocate `action_code` with a tenant-scoped DB sequence and preserve `UNIQUE(tenant_id,action_code)`. Distinct revision/Foundation basis/rule/asset keys permit several Actions per Finding. Each event has `UNIQUE(action_id,idempotency_key)` and payload digest; identical retry returns the original event, conflicting reuse is 409.

Rule `reserve-trial-1` is a server-computed policy-sensitivity trial. Require a reviewed, `SUPPORTED`, current `GENERATOR_SUPPORT_CANDIDATE` FindingRevision. Its pinned assessment must cite at least one Candidate segment whose **accepted analytic input** contains a usable numeric battery-SOC reading strictly greater than that segment's pinned effective reserve plus the dispatch model's 10-point headroom. Read the numeric SOC, segment/assessment/evidence IDs and digest from that persisted accepted analytic input, not Finding prose, a mock number or private Lab truth. Its cited Foundation must have one unambiguous percent battery reserve on the same battery asset, and the current Site Foundation reserve must equal that pinned reserve. For reserve `r` in [15, 90], propose exactly `r - 5` percentage points in [10, 85]. Serve a typed unavailable reason for non-current or unsupported revision, absent Candidate, missing/conflicting/non-numeric SOC, SOC at or below `r + 10`, missing/conflicting reserve or unit, asset mismatch, stale Foundation basis, reserve outside [15, 90], or unchanged result. Pin all input IDs/digest, rule/version, old/proposed values and limitation. Boundary tests cover SOC exactly `r + 10` versus just above, reserves 15/90 and just outside, missing/conflicting inputs, asset and current-basis mismatches. This experiment does not diagnose the Finding cause or predict runtime, saving or safety; never derive it from the mock generator-stop narrative. An S4 money consequence is shown only for its exact basis, labelled consequence.

Before acceptance, recommendation proposal or unavailability is **served from persisted inputs**, with no recommendation row. On acceptance, store an immutable accepted-recommendation snapshot on `action` or an append-only Action-owned child: canonical key, rule ID/version, assessment/evidence IDs and digest, pinned FoundationRevision ID, asset, exact reserve field, percent unit, old/proposed numeric values and stable limitation text/code. After an Action exists for the key, `GET recommendation` returns this accepted snapshot and Action link even if the current reserve has changed; a separately labelled live recomputation status may then be stale/unavailable. The accepted proposal never disappears or changes on reload.

The exact SOC source is the accepted analytic input role `battery_soc` in percent, with `SOC_HEADROOM_POINTS = 10` (`backend/assetops_backend/analytics/dispatch_v3.py:44,53,166-194,255-259,287-300`); carry its selected reading/evidence IDs through the pinned assessment and Candidate segment.

| Command | Precondition | Event / reduced state | Refusal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| accept | reviewed persisted revision; valid recommendation; scoped server-authorized SYSTEM demo capability | ACCEPTED / application pending | missing auth 401, denied authority 403, unknown/wrong-Site Finding or revision 404, invalid proposal typed 422; no Action/event |
| apply | ACCEPTED; expected current Foundation ID; same Site/asset/value; prospective effective time; scoped capability | APPLIED only with committed new Foundation; outcome pending | authorized same-Site domain/publish failure appends FAILED after rollback: stale 409, invalid/no-change/backdate 422; unknown/wrong-Site Action/change 404, missing auth 401, denied authority 403 append nothing |
| apply on APPLIED Action with a new key | already APPLIED | no event or new publish | typed `ACTION_ALREADY_APPLIED` 409; no FAILED because publish was not attempted |
| retry after FAILED | application remains ACCEPTED/pending | old identical key returns its FAILED event; a fresh attempt uses a new key and can become APPLIED | conflicting reuse 409 |
| repeat successful command | identical command key and payload | return original Action/event/artifact before no-change validation | same key, different payload 409 |
| observe demo note | ACCEPTED exists; scoped SYSTEM capability; fixed `DEMO_REVIEW_NOTE` code | append state-neutral OBSERVED; application and verification state unchanged | missing/denied authority 401/403, unknown/wrong-Site Action 404, time bounds typed 422, conflicting key 409; no event on refusal |

FAILED is an attempt event and never claims an effective change. Reduce by `(recorded_at,id)`. Accept/apply use server time. `OBSERVED` alone may carry an explicit earlier `occurred_at`, displayed separately; it never reorders state. Do not infer Verified or human approval. With no verified operator principal, only labelled server-authorized SYSTEM demonstration commands run, carrying stable service principal and triggering job/command/fixture. No client, gateway or OS name becomes a human author.

## Read contract (route, DTO and cursor are new)

Add `GET /api/sites/{site_code}/finding-index?domain=mini-grid-dispatch&from=<UTC>&to=<UTC>&limit=<bounded>&cursor=<opaque>`. `mini-grid-dispatch` is a **new API domain token**: resolve it to stored `finding.domain='mini_grid' AND finding.analytic_id='dispatch'`, the S3 `dispatch` discovery basis, and the S4 matcher `MATCHER_VERSION` on that basis (`analytics/finding_episode.py:78,76` on the stacked base; `:68` for `DOMAIN` on main; `analytics/dispatch.py:27`; `analytics/assessment_worker.py:51`). Resolve tenant/Site via Finding access before discovery: established 401/403/404 and no foreign count. Require the explicit supported domain and UTC half-open `[from,to)`, `from < to`, maximum 31 UTC days; any other domain or invalid input receives typed 422, with no status, rows or count, never `CURRENT` zero. Echo the requested and resolved domain/analytic, Site, UTC window and display timezone. The UI persists Site/domain/dates in its URL; date change makes a new read. Server bounds page size.

Return `schema_version`, Site/domain/window, display timezone/access basis, selection token, `knowledge_at`, `built_at`, typed status/reasons, coverage/limitations, watermarks, rows, `total_count` and `next_cursor`. `total_count` is null unless status is `CURRENT`. Watermarks contain accepted-source marker, S3 selected assessment/run/input/configuration and analytic selection, S4 matcher/version/pass/selection. Each row has stable `(tenant_id,site_id,finding_id)` key, canonical Finding UUID, exact `finding_revision_id`, episode bounds, lifecycle/transition, selected assessment/run/model/cohort, cited accepted-evidence/configuration IDs, limitations, relation/history links and `/sites/{site_code}/findings/{finding_id}?revision_id={revision_id}`. Exact links survive reload and newer revisions; lineage comes from the selected immutable revision.

Use one transactionally consistent read (no published projection in S4-04); `knowledge_at` is a selection cutoff, not arbitrary commit-ordered replay. **Complete discovery** starts with every UTC-day analytic window intersecting `[from,to)` and repeatedly inspects adjacent UTC days reachable across the current edge through an actual S4 20-minute continuity bridge on one fenced accepted-evidence/configuration/model basis, until a fixed point. This can extend beyond one neighbour on either side. Every inspected day needs S3 selection and canonical S4 match through its current selection seq; record each day and its S3/S4 selection seq in the selection token, including days with no row. Cap discovery at 62 distinct UTC-day windows total, including requested days. If the next reachable day exceeds the cap, return 409 `INDEX_CONTINUITY_LIMIT` with a reason and no rows, count or empty claim; this service cap does not prove continuity ended. Fence before/after read. Moving selection, affected dirty/leased/failed work, watermark mismatch, or late evidence/configuration/model change blocks `CURRENT`. A source-coverage limitation can coexist with a current assessment of available evidence, but cannot assert physical completeness.

`PENDING` means no usable completed selection; `UNASSESSED` no completed discovery basis; `STALE_PROJECTION` and `FAILED` may expose rows only from a durable prior selected snapshot holding exact canonical Finding/FindingRevision IDs, sort order and response basis. Recheck scope and label such rows/count historical, never current. S4-04 builds **no durable snapshot**, migration or new writer. Consequently stale/failed reads return no rows and null `total_count`; use `PENDING` or `UNASSESSED` when no usable completed selection exists, and `FAILED` may report the failure without historical rows. Never reconstruct stale rows from newer heads. None authorizes current count, empty/Healthy assertion or swapping stale links for a new head. A closed S3 Performance source gate returns 409 `PERFORMANCE_CUTOVER_CLOSED` with its reason and no rows/count/empty claim; exact pinned detail remains a separate audit route. Consume S4-05's reviewed stored gate form when merged.

One row per canonical Finding; merged-away IDs remain relationship links. Extension changes its revision; separated recurrence gets another Finding ID and link. Include closed and unconfirmed episodes. Intersect iff `episode_start < to && episode_end > from`; boundary touch is excluded. Order selected `episode_start` descending, then stable Finding UUID ascending; never by money, lifecycle or arrival. Cursor binds tenant/Site/domain/window, basis/selection token and last sort key. A well-formed cursor whose bound scope or fenced basis changed returns 409 `INDEX_BASIS_CHANGED` with a machine-readable reason and instruction to request page one without a cursor; return no rows, count or replacement cursor. A malformed cursor returns typed 422. Pages cannot splice revision sets. No priority tuple until a producer is reviewed.

Optional amount cell starts **unavailable**. On the stacked S5-01/LR-01 baseline, LR-01 `money_eligibility` is reviewed but S4-05 stored accepted-ID provenance is unmerged: show no current amount. After **both** reviewed contracts enter the baseline, separate review may allow amount only for the exact selected FindingRevision/window/basis and consequence head, open source, current list/consequence, eligible series, priced quantity/price and known source/display unit. Withheld/pending, mixed/unknown source, stale, wrong revision/window, unpriced or closed source means no current amount; old values use explicit audit links. No sum, savings inference or unpriced-as-zero. Money does not gate row/empty delivery.

The [v6.9 screen realization map](../frontend/docs/architecture/v69-screen-realization-map.md), [screen ledger](../frontend/docs/architecture/v69-screen-ledger.json), [model homes](../frontend/docs/architecture/v69-model-homes.json) and [panel contracts](../frontend/docs/architecture/v69-panel-contracts.json) are Architect planning overlays, not accepted screen completion. The owner approved `Real with honest gaps` as the W1 target for 27 screens, including six moved from W4, and their exact core keys/values; later-wave tiers remain pending. The manifest ID and its `visual_reference` key each later comparison; `GAP` in a panel contract means no supported claim yet. Run `python frontend/docs/architecture/check_v69_ledger.py` after ledger changes.

For each `Deferred` screen, the ledger's `promotion_dependencies.to_candidate` lists the design, projection, fixture and task gates before it can enter the executable queue. # S6-02a â€” Frozen verification and exact read

Freeze before later run or first later accepted report: Action, origin FindingRevision, APPLIED event, old/new covering FoundationRevision, baseline selected S3 assessment/run and accepted IDs, model/cohort/clock/source basis, target, guardrails, version-1 bands, coverage and two explicit half-open 60-minute UTC windows aligned to UTC five-minute boundaries. Baseline ends before new effective_from; later starts at/after it; neither straddles a policy change. Same clock hour/duration/Site/asset/model/signal roles. A replacement always gets a new immutable plan ID and `supersedes_plan_id`; it may reuse baseline/later bounds only while no later-window report has been accepted **and** no later run has begun. After either cutoff event it needs a new later window. Idempotent retry of the original freeze returns its ID; superseded plans remain addressable. Baseline needs positive supported Candidate seconds. Freeze baseline UTC-day revision IDs and later selection rule; append immutable later day-selection binding before evaluation, pin both ID sets in outcome. Different covering FoundationRevision, backdated included, yields REASSESSMENT_PENDING then INCONCLUSIVE unless a new comparable plan is frozen.

Target: intersect `CANDIDATE_AVOIDABLE` segments with each `[start,end)` window and sum integer seconds. Use latest selected UTC-day `dispatch-3` revisions under S3 bracket/continuity. **Include previous UTC day's revision when an interval starts then but crosses into the later window**; test a cross-midnight Candidate segment against silent seconds loss. Check parent interval `OPEN_BOUND`: any segment time of any class inside a window from that interval makes target INCONCLUSIVE. Intersecting INDETERMINATE time does too. Do not add S3 60-minute kind or substitute all generator time, money or Finding count. Require `4 * later_seconds <= 3 * baseline_seconds`. Both windows need final S3 selection and complete S4 episode reassessment; later NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED only corroborates.

Each window has exactly twelve half-open UTC slots `[t,t+5 min)`. Every required slot needs accepted generator state/power, feeder demand for **every bound load asset**, PV-available power, battery SOC, time-valid effective reserve, requested and delivered critical-load power, dispatch capability inputs and clock/cohort proof. For each power role, accept one time-valid value covering the whole slot or accepted non-overlapping subinterval values that exactly partition it; integrate `kW * covered seconds / 3600` into kWh. Point readings alone establish no power energy: the public report must declare interval semantics. Reject gaps, conflicting overlaps, interpolation, missing/negative/ambiguous/non-finite inputs. SOC needs an accepted sample at each slot start and at the window end; the start sample represents its slot, while the end sample is terminal SOC. Use the reserve effective at each slot start; a mid-slot reserve change makes that slot unassessable. Do not carry samples across missing boundaries. Add **new versioned public role set** after `minigrid-roles-2`, five-minute Lab publication profile publishing interval-valued power, and versioned binding/readiness/missing-input messages for Lab and real-Site onboarding. Both critical-load roles are time-valid power. The Lab already exposes per-load demand/served power in `backend/assetops_backend/simulator_lab_api.py:1052-1058,1429-1436`; the new public profile derives requested/delivered critical power from those kernel per-load values and publishes them through ordinary gateway/S2 acceptance. Preserve historic role-set interpretation; private simulator state fills no public gap. Missing slot/role => INCONCLUSIVE, regardless of improvement elsewhere. Existing gateway/S2 point-reading handling for the new roles is a phase-1 risk: prove interval declarations survive acceptance.

Version-1 comparability bands are frozen in plan and API fixture: later total feeder-demand energy and later total PV-available energy must each be within 10% of their baseline total, inclusive; initial battery SOC within 2 percentage points, inclusive. Sum every bound load asset for feeder-demand energy; one missing binding in either window fails comparability and never shrinks the total. A zero baseline energy total requires a zero later total. Compare exact decimal/rational values before display rounding; no evaluator or fixture widens a frozen band. Site, asset, model, roles, cohort rule and clock basis match exactly. Compute unserved critical energy from requested minus delivered accepted power over matched intervals; later <= baseline. Count 300 below-reserve seconds per slot whose start SOC is below the start reserve; later count must be zero and <= baseline. Label this a **five-minute sampled guardrail**, never continuous physical SOC proof. Terminal SOC at equal horizon >= baseline after the initial-SOC comparability check. Unmeasurable guardrail/comparability is unknown. Store metric, threshold, unit, evidence IDs and reason. Full target and guardrail pass => VERIFIED; fully assessable target miss or measured guardrail fail => INEFFECTIVE, with `GUARDRAIL_FAIL` reason only for measured guardrail failure. Unknown required fact => INCONCLUSIVE even with known failure, which remains in details. Before closed/settled later window, PENDING is read state, not outcome.

Resolve S4-05 source **per window, never their union**. Positive demo verdict requires coherent REGISTERED_SIMULATION or explicitly AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION per window, same class and registered scenario/profile lineage, distinct run identity digests and intact links. Pin resolutions/digests; MIXED, UNKNOWN, crossed classes or broken links => INCONCLUSIVE. No positive real-source verdict before separate real attestation. Label result simulated/authored policy trial; no causal/savings language.

Late accepted evidence, changed clock/source classification, pending/failed S3 or S4 work immediately makes current read REASSESSMENT_PENDING and withdraws Verified/Resolved presentation; keep old outcome addressable. A SYSTEM demo evaluation request after relevant S3/S4 reassessment settles triggers the evaluator to append the new outcome and, where needed, RESOLUTION_WITHDRAWN; no UI write of verdict/event is allowed. +# S7-01a — Central source health and asset boundary reads
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after independent review. Size M, two phases. Branch `task/S7-01a-health-read` from merged main. Depends on S2-02 central diagnostics and S1-02 effective bindings. Authority: `.agent/architect-W1-remaining-answers.md`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md` `D-2026-10-16-a-s7-health`, `D-2026-10-09-pre-s3-evidence-readiness-health`; registry `D-edge-health-cases`, `I-source-health-read`, `I-asset-boundary-read`. No UI/panel promotion in this part.
+
+## Verified seams and new contract
+
+Existing central diagnostic selection: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/adapters/postgres_gateway_access.py:172-194`; cadence contact and diagnostic fields: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/gateway_access.py:289-343`; `GET /api/sites/{site_id}/gateway-health`: `backend/assetops_backend/gateway_api.py:38,93-109`; existing client: `frontend/src/sites/gatewayHealthClient.ts:3,68`. Existing S1 basis/binding tables: `backend/migrations/versions/0001_foundation_identity.py`, `0002_signal_bindings.py`. **New:** two-clock Site source-health interpretation/read and Site/asset-scoped configured-battery boundary read/API; neither is a physical health assessment.
+
+Site read resolves registered gateway/source IDs, most recent centrally stored diagnostic per gateway, local sequence, diagnostic ID, server `received_at`, reported `observed_at`, cadence, read time, source watermark, source-specific contact time where supplied, queue depth/oldest age, clock offset/trust and disk pressure. Receipt freshness `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` is distinct from reported-fact age/trust and `STALE_PROJECTION`. Fresh receipt of old facts may have current gateway contact and old/Unknown facts. Gateway contact never proves source-device contact. No registered gateway = `NO_REGISTERED_SOURCE`; registered never received = `UNKNOWN`. Stale receipt does not date an outage; queue/disk are last reported, not current hardware state. Store failure or inconsistent registration/diagnostic selection cannot yield a current claim. No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.
+
+Battery read resolves effective Site basis and configured asset/binding IDs. Return `UNKNOWN` physical condition with named missing accepted causal temperature/capacity/stress inputs, or `NOT_CONFIGURED`/Unknown reason if absent/unbound. SOC and nameplate may appear only under separate evidence/declared labels and exact accepted IDs. Withhold degradation, remaining life, stress score, warranty/replacement exposure and diagnosis. Enforce tenant/Site/asset 401/403/404; a foreign asset is never an empty healthy row.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable and focused proof |
+| --- | --- |
+| 1. Central fixture/read | **New** `D-edge-health-cases` through registered gateway authentication and central ingestion: current heartbeat, stale cadence, delayed old diagnostic freshly received, growing queue/old item, clock offset/untrusted time, disk pressure/acquisition stop then recovery; also never received and wrong Site. Assert ID, sequence, server/reported times and reload. Add `backend/tests/test_s7_source_health_postgres.py` (new), including refusal and stale-projection cases. |
+| 2. Asset boundary/review | **New** configured battery with missing causal input, unbound/absent battery and wrong asset/Site checks in `backend/tests/test_s7_asset_boundary_postgres.py` (new). Pin basis/binding IDs after reload. If DDL is needed, allocate after main's `0018_finding_match_deferral`; S6-02a adds unmerged `0019_verification_core`, so re-chain migration at merge. Order `created_at DESC, action_id ASC`; bounded page and opaque cursor bind tenant, Site, window, selection fence and last sort key.
+- Echo scope/display timezone, `read_at`, max included creation/event-recorded fence or explicit zero-row fence, total and next cursor. `CURRENT` only after successful scoped read. Zero means no persisted Actions created in this Site/window. A changed fence invalidates page 2 and requires reload from page 1. Preserve historical Action detail separately.
+- 401 unauthenticated, 403 known forbidden, 404 foreign/nonexistent Site or root. Invalid/unbounded window, changed cursor, unavailable store or inconsistent snapshot is typed refusal, never empty success. UI keeps Site/window in URL, shows count/page basis, exact FindingRevision and ActionEvent links, Unknown/error distinctly, native keyboard navigation and no invented verification result.

No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.

SOC and nameplate may appear only under separate evidence/declared labels and exact accepted IDs. Withhold degradation, remaining life, stress score, warranty/replacement exposure and diagnosis. +# S3-02a — Selected assessment capability and claim-limit reads
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after independent review. Size M, two phases. Branch `task/S3-02a-capability-read` from merged main. Depends on reviewed/merged S3-01 selected assessment and accepted `I-sim-dispatch-cases`. Authority: `.agent/architect-W1-remaining-answers.md`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md` `D-2026-10-16-s302-capability`, `D-2026-10-09-pre-s3-evidence-readiness-health`; registry `I-capability-read`, `I-claim-limit-read`. This part does not promote `evidence-analysis:2#b`.
+
+## Verified seams and read contract
+
+Existing selected day/window status, basis, coverage, watermarks and limitations: `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/dispatch_read.py:123-166`; exact revision lineage `:178-202`; routes `backend/assetops_backend/performance_api.py:88-101`; S3 tests `backend/tests/test_s3_dispatch_read_postgres.py`, `test_s3_dispatch_assessment_postgres.py`. S2 explanation is separate in `frontend/src/sites/LedgerSiteEvidence.tsx:1115`. **New:** versioned `CapabilityReadiness` and claim-ceiling service/API for one authenticated mini-grid Site, half-open UTC day and exact selected S3 dispatch window/interval `assessment_revision_id`, using that assessment's accepted public `EvidenceQuery`/`AnalyticInputSet`. Do not select later readings or another revision.
+
+Echo tenant/Site, day/window, revision, run/model/cohort, knowledge cutoff, effective Foundation/binding IDs, accepted evidence IDs, source/analytic watermarks, `built_at` and `read_at`. Return per-required-role covered duration/quality, missing/conflicted spans, selection/rule basis and named limitations. Versioned claim-limit mapping bounds the selected dispatch classification to Candidate/Necessary/Indeterminate support; no physical capacity inferred from configured capability. Positive ceiling requires current exact S3 selection, complete relevant rule assessment and accepted public role evidence. Current assessment may still be `LIMITED` or `UNKNOWN` in portions. No assessment = `UNASSESSED`; pending/failed/dirty/changed selection = `PENDING`/`FAILED`/`STALE_PROJECTION` and no current positive claim. Prior exact revision may be read as historical only. Reject foreign Site/revision, revision outside selected window, unsupported rule version and absent accepted lineage; 401/403/404 identity boundary applies.

+## Architect questions

+# S7-01a — Central source health and asset boundary reads
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after independent review. Size M, two phases. Branch `task/S7-01a-health-read` from merged main. No UI/panel promotion in this part.

+## Verified seams and new contract
+
+Existing central diagnostic selection: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/adapters/postgres_gateway_access.py:172-194`; cadence contact and diagnostic fields: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/gateway_access.py:289-343`; `GET /api/sites/{site_id}/gateway-health`: `backend/assetops_backend/gateway_api.py:38,93-109`; existing client: `frontend/src/sites/gatewayHealthClient.ts:3,68`. +
+Site read resolves registered gateway/source IDs, most recent centrally stored diagnostic per gateway, local sequence, diagnostic ID, server `received_at`, reported `observed_at`, cadence, read time, source watermark, source-specific contact time where supplied, queue depth/oldest age, clock offset/trust and disk pressure. Receipt freshness `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` is distinct from reported-fact age/trust and `STALE_PROJECTION`. Fresh receipt of old facts may have current gateway contact and old/Unknown facts. Gateway contact never proves source-device contact. No registered gateway = `NO_REGISTERED_SOURCE`; registered never received = `UNKNOWN`. Stale receipt does not date an outage; queue/disk are last reported, not current hardware state. Store failure or inconsistent registration/diagnostic selection cannot yield a current claim. No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.
+
+Battery read resolves effective Site basis and configured asset/binding IDs. Return `UNKNOWN` physical condition with named missing accepted causal temperature/capacity/stress inputs, or `NOT_CONFIGURED`/Unknown reason if absent/unbound. SOC and nameplate may appear only under separate evidence/declared labels and exact accepted IDs. Withhold degradation, remaining life, stress score, warranty/replacement exposure and diagnosis. Enforce tenant/Site/asset 401/403/404; a foreign asset is never an empty healthy row.

+## Read and UI contract
+
+- One consistent DB snapshot selects `created_at >= from AND created_at < to` and latest event by `(recorded_at,id)`, never `occurred_at`. +- Echo scope/display timezone, `read_at`, max included creation/event-recorded fence or explicit zero-row fence, total and next cursor. `CURRENT` only after successful scoped read. Zero means no persisted Actions created in this Site/window. A changed fence invalidates page 2 and requires reload from page 1. Preserve historical Action detail separately.
+- 401 unauthenticated, 403 known forbidden, 404 foreign/nonexistent Site or root. Invalid/unbounded window, changed cursor, unavailable store or inconsistent snapshot is typed refusal, never empty success. UI keeps Site/window in URL, shows count/page basis, exact FindingRevision and ActionEvent links, Unknown/error distinctly, native keyboard navigation and no invented verification result.

+# S7-01a — Central source health and asset boundary reads
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after independent review. Size M, two phases. Branch `task/S7-01a-health-read` from merged main. +## Verified seams and new contract
+
+Existing central diagnostic selection: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/adapters/postgres_gateway_access.py:172-194`; cadence contact and diagnostic fields: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/gateway_access.py:289-343`; `GET /api/sites/{site_id}/gateway-health`: `backend/assetops_backend/gateway_api.py:38,93-109`; existing client: `frontend/src/sites/gatewayHealthClient.ts:3,68`. +
+Site read resolves registered gateway/source IDs, most recent centrally stored diagnostic per gateway, local sequence, diagnostic ID, server `received_at`, reported `observed_at`, cadence, read time, source watermark, source-specific contact time where supplied, queue depth/oldest age, clock offset/trust and disk pressure. Gateway contact never proves source-device contact. No registered gateway = `NO_REGISTERED_SOURCE`; registered never received = `UNKNOWN`. Stale receipt does not date an outage; queue/disk are last reported, not current hardware state. Store failure or inconsistent registration/diagnostic selection cannot yield a current claim. No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.

+# S7-01a — Central source health and asset boundary reads
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after independent review. Size M, two phases. Branch `task/S7-01a-health-read` from merged main. Depends on S2-02 central diagnostics and S1-02 effective bindings. No UI/panel promotion in this part.
+
+## Verified seams and new contract
+
+Existing central diagnostic selection: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/adapters/postgres_gateway_access.py:172-194`; cadence contact and diagnostic fields: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/gateway_access.py:289-343`; `GET /api/sites/{site_id}/gateway-health`: `backend/assetops_backend/gateway_api.py:38,93-109`; existing client: `frontend/src/sites/gatewayHealthClient.ts:3,68`. Existing S1 basis/binding tables: `backend/migrations/versions/0001_foundation_identity.py`, `0002_signal_bindings.py`. **New:** two-clock Site source-health interpretation/read and Site/asset-scoped configured-battery boundary read/API; neither is a physical health assessment.
+
+Site read resolves registered gateway/source IDs, most recent centrally stored diagnostic per gateway, local sequence, diagnostic ID, server `received_at`, reported `observed_at`, cadence, read time, source watermark, source-specific contact time where supplied, queue depth/oldest age, clock offset/trust and disk pressure. Receipt freshness `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` is distinct from reported-fact age/trust and `STALE_PROJECTION`. Fresh receipt of old facts may have current gateway contact and old/Unknown facts. Gateway contact never proves source-device contact. No registered gateway = `NO_REGISTERED_SOURCE`; registered never received = `UNKNOWN`. Stale receipt does not date an outage; queue/disk are last reported, not current hardware state. Store failure or inconsistent registration/diagnostic selection cannot yield a current claim. No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.
+
+Battery read resolves effective Site basis and configured asset/binding IDs. Return `UNKNOWN` physical condition with named missing accepted causal temperature/capacity/stress inputs, or `NOT_CONFIGURED`/Unknown reason if absent/unbound. SOC and nameplate may appear only under separate evidence/declared labels and exact accepted IDs. Withhold degradation, remaining life, stress score, warranty/replacement exposure and diagnosis. Enforce tenant/Site/asset 401/403/404; a foreign asset is never an empty healthy row.

frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp-technical-design.md:29:`foundation_revision` holds the public Site definition, not simulated world inputs. `signal_binding_revision` is both the server's registered gateway mapping and the semantic role binding; gateway downloads an immutable versioned snapshot with a canonical content hash over an authenticated channel. A mapping set must reference an effective Foundation revision and every bound asset/channel must exist at publication. The raw envelope still states its mapping set/version for audit. A batch is homogeneous in mapping and Foundation reference; the gateway closes one batch and opens another when either changes. Ingestion checks that the **referenced registered versions' original valid ranges** cover each envelope's source time, even if a later configuration correction superseded them while the gateway was offline. It records the accepted-as basis and flags an outdated mapping/configuration; it rejects unregistered versions or times outside the referenced range. Analytics at a later `knowledge_at` may rebind and renormalize the immutable original reading under a corrected time-valid version, recording those new revision IDs in its input set. This never edits accepted evidence. A record dated before any configured period is rejected with a specific reason; it is not assigned current configuration.

frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp-technical-design.md:90:**Crash sequence:** device report → map/validate → `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` → read/increment sequence → derive message ID from `(site,gateway,source,epoch,sequence)` → insert canonical envelope and bytes → commit → select READY rows and seal homogeneous batch in a second transaction → POST → verify receipt digest/IDs/count → persist ack and state in one transaction. On restart, reset `IN_FLIGHT` batches to retryable; never recreate a sealed payload. `ACKED` may be compacted after configured retention and backed-up receipt checkpoint; `DEAD_LETTER` and unacknowledged rows remain. Disk pressure stops acquisition visibly rather than dropping evidence silently. If a device provides a durable event ID, store it in the report metadata and use it for duplicate suppression **before** sequence assignment; otherwise repeated physical samples are distinct events and never silently conflated.

frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp-technical-design.md:131:The existing v1/v2 envelope and v1 batch parser remain read-compatible for stored demo history. V3 **changes identity semantics**: `message_id = SHA256(length-delimited(site_id,gateway_id,source_id,sequence_epoch,sequence))`, with the tuple durably allocated once. Exact byte framing and test vectors are part of the contract task; do not concatenate without separators or trust a sender-supplied digest. Sequence scope is `(gateway,source,epoch)`; monotonic arrival is not required. `published_at` is when gateway seals publication, not a second measurement time. Source clock uncertainty is expressed as quality/diagnostic metadata, never correction of `source_time`. Batch V2 is homogeneous in source/mapping/Foundation reference; each envelope is still checked against effective configuration at its own time. The batch hash is over canonical bytes excluding the `payload_sha256` field; the receipt hash similarly excludes `receipt_sha256`. Batch `source_mode` is compared with authenticated gateway registration and is only provenance after that check. Wire IDs for site/gateway/source resolve registered UUID rows; device/signal IDs remain scoped source strings. A production batch must not carry Lab-private cause or truth; keep any Lab run reference in a private manifest keyed by batch ID.

frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp-technical-design.md:183:**Initial API contract:** `POST /api/ingestion/batches` returns terminal `200` receipt or `202 IN_PROGRESS` receipt; `GET /api/ingestion/batches/{id}` returns the same durable state. `409` is reserved for same batch ID/different bytes or registered identity conflict, `422` for malformed contract, `401/403` for authentication/authorization. frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp-technical-design.md:185:**Gateway diagnostic API:** `POST /api/gateways/{gateway_id}/diagnostics` authenticates the registered gateway/site, checks `GatewayDiagnosticsV1` identity/hash and inserts `gateway_diagnostic` with server `received_at`; an identical retry returns the existing row. `409` refuses identity reuse with different bytes, `422` malformed fields, and `401/403` wrong credential/scope. `GET /api/sites/{id}/gateway-health` returns last server contact, declared cadence, source-contact observations, queue age/depth, disk pressure, clock offset and an explicit `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` status with diagnostic ID and receive time. frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:39:### Edge gateway
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:41:Adapters poll or subscribe to Modbus/serial, meters, PLC/BMS and vendor HTTP/OPC-UA interfaces as actually encountered at a pilot; each yields a typed device report with source clock, unit, quality and device identity. Site-local, versioned mapping binds `(device, signal)` to a canonical signal/semantic role, applies documented unit conversion, and rejects unknown or incompatible readings. The gateway generates `SourceEnvelope` after mapping, with `source_time`, `published_at`, quality/unavailable reason, interval bounds where relevant, gateway/source/device/signal IDs, mapping version and a stable message identity. Preserve bytes and IDs across restarts, backoff with jitter, retry identical batch bytes, and delete/compact only after the server confirms each envelope's accepted/duplicate/rejected/conflict outcome and the acknowledgement is durable locally. Rejected/conflicting messages move to an inspectable dead-letter state; a whole-batch refusal retains the batch for operator repair. +# S7-01a — Central source health and asset boundary reads
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after independent review. Size M, two phases. Branch `task/S7-01a-health-read` from merged main. No UI/panel promotion in this part.
+
+## Verified seams and new contract
+
+Existing central diagnostic selection: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/adapters/postgres_gateway_access.py:172-194`; cadence contact and diagnostic fields: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/gateway_access.py:289-343`; `GET /api/sites/{site_id}/gateway-health`: `backend/assetops_backend/gateway_api.py:38,93-109`; existing client: `frontend/src/sites/gatewayHealthClient.ts:3,68`. Existing S1 basis/binding tables: `backend/migrations/versions/0001_foundation_identity.py`, `0002_signal_bindings.py`. **New:** two-clock Site source-health interpretation/read and Site/asset-scoped configured-battery boundary read/API; neither is a physical health assessment.
+
+Site read resolves registered gateway/source IDs, most recent centrally stored diagnostic per gateway, local sequence, diagnostic ID, server `received_at`, reported `observed_at`, cadence, read time, source watermark, source-specific contact time where supplied, queue depth/oldest age, clock offset/trust and disk pressure. Receipt freshness `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` is distinct from reported-fact age/trust and `STALE_PROJECTION`. Fresh receipt of old facts may have current gateway contact and old/Unknown facts. Gateway contact never proves source-device contact. No registered gateway = `NO_REGISTERED_SOURCE`; registered never received = `UNKNOWN`. Stale receipt does not date an outage; queue/disk are last reported, not current hardware state. Store failure or inconsistent registration/diagnostic selection cannot yield a current claim. No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.
+
+Battery read resolves effective Site basis and configured asset/binding IDs. Return `UNKNOWN` physical condition with named missing accepted causal temperature/capacity/stress inputs, or `NOT_CONFIGURED`/Unknown reason if absent/unbound. SOC and nameplate may appear only under separate evidence/declared labels and exact accepted IDs. Withhold degradation, remaining life, stress score, warranty/replacement exposure and diagnosis. Enforce tenant/Site/asset 401/403/404; a foreign asset is never an empty healthy row.

+# S7-01a — Central source health and asset boundary reads
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after independent review. Size M, two phases. Branch `task/S7-01a-health-read` from merged main. Depends on S2-02 central diagnostics and S1-02 effective bindings. Authority: `.agent/architect-W1-remaining-answers.md`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md` `D-2026-10-16-a-s7-health`, `D-2026-10-09-pre-s3-evidence-readiness-health`; registry `D-edge-health-cases`, `I-source-health-read`, `I-asset-boundary-read`. No UI/panel promotion in this part.
+
+## Verified seams and new contract
+
+Existing central diagnostic selection: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/adapters/postgres_gateway_access.py:172-194`; cadence contact and diagnostic fields: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/gateway_access.py:289-343`; `GET /api/sites/{site_id}/gateway-health`: `backend/assetops_backend/gateway_api.py:38,93-109`; existing client: `frontend/src/sites/gatewayHealthClient.ts:3,68`. Existing S1 basis/binding tables: `backend/migrations/versions/0001_foundation_identity.py`, `0002_signal_bindings.py`. **New:** two-clock Site source-health interpretation/read and Site/asset-scoped configured-battery boundary read/API; neither is a physical health assessment.
+
+Site read resolves registered gateway/source IDs, most recent centrally stored diagnostic per gateway, local sequence, diagnostic ID, server `received_at`, reported `observed_at`, cadence, read time, source watermark, source-specific contact time where supplied, queue depth/oldest age, clock offset/trust and disk pressure. Receipt freshness `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` is distinct from reported-fact age/trust and `STALE_PROJECTION`. Fresh receipt of old facts may have current gateway contact and old/Unknown facts. Gateway contact never proves source-device contact. No registered gateway = `NO_REGISTERED_SOURCE`; registered never received = `UNKNOWN`. Stale receipt does not date an outage; queue/disk are last reported, not current hardware state. Store failure or inconsistent registration/diagnostic selection cannot yield a current claim. No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.
+
+Battery read resolves effective Site basis and configured asset/binding IDs. Return `UNKNOWN` physical condition with named missing accepted causal temperature/capacity/stress inputs, or `NOT_CONFIGURED`/Unknown reason if absent/unbound. SOC and nameplate may appear only under separate evidence/declared labels and exact accepted IDs. Withhold degradation, remaining life, stress score, warranty/replacement exposure and diagnosis. Enforce tenant/Site/asset 401/403/404; a foreign asset is never an empty healthy row.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable and focused proof |
+| --- | --- |
+| 1. Central fixture/read | **New** `D-edge-health-cases` through registered gateway authentication and central ingestion: current heartbeat, stale cadence, delayed old diagnostic freshly received, growing queue/old item, clock offset/untrusted time, disk pressure/acquisition stop then recovery; also never received and wrong Site. Assert ID, sequence, server/reported times and reload. Add `backend/tests/test_s7_source_health_postgres.py` (new), including refusal and stale-projection cases. |
+| 2. Asset boundary/review | **New** configured battery with missing causal input, unbound/absent battery and wrong asset/Site checks in `backend/tests/test_s7_asset_boundary_postgres.py` (new). Pin basis/binding IDs after reload. If DDL is needed, allocate after main's `0018_finding_match_deferral`; S6-02a adds unmerged `0019_verification_core`, so re-chain migration at merge. Audit any new writer/fixture SQL against statement-level rule 8 and run `python tools/writer_guard_probes.py`. Run `tools/check-all.ps1`, registry checker and one final-revision full backend suite with private `*_test` DB per `backend/TESTING.md:104,112-125`: `pytest backend/tests -n 2 --dist loadfile --no-loadscope-reorder -q --junitxml=.pytest-junit.xml`, keep-awake, 20-minute cap, JUnit zero skipped/failed. Fresh independent review permits merge; S7-01b consumes this contract. |
+
+## Architect questions
+
+1. **Recommendation:** expose a versioned read DTO for fact age/trust rather than mutate S2 gateway-health fields in place; select diagnostics and registration in one DB snapshot.

    def serve(self, port: int, web: int) -> None:
        self.ids()
        logs = self.work / "logs"
        logs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        log = open(logs / f"api-{port}.log", "w", encoding="utf-8")
        proc = subprocess.Popen([str(PY), "-m", "uvicorn", "lab_app:app", "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--port", str(port)],
                                cwd=str(self.tree / "host"), env=self.env(), stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        say(f"API on http://127.0.0.1:{port} (log {logs / f'api-{port}.log'}), pid {proc.pid}")
        say(f"Grants: {self.work / 'action-demo-grants.json'} (this database's tenant/Site, fixture Findings only)")
        say(f'Frontend, from frontend/:  $env:ASSETOPS_API_PORT="{port}"; npm.cmd run dev -- --port {web} --strictPort')
        self.links(web)
        try:
            proc.wait()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            proc.terminate()

    def drop(self) -> None:
        import psycopg

        recorded = self.marker_db()
        with psycopg.connect(PG_ADMIN, autocommit=True) as c:
            if self.db_exists(c):
                if recorded != self.db:
                    raise SystemExit(f"Not dropping {self.db}: {self.work / MARKER} does not record that this tool "
                                     f"made it (recorded: {recorded or 'nothing'})")
                c.execute(f"DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS {self.db} WITH (FORCE)")
                say(f"dropped database {self.db}")
            else:
                say(f"database {self.db} does not exist")
        if self.work.exists():
            if not self.owned():
                raise SystemExit(f"Not removing {self.work}: it has no {MARKER} marker")
            if recorded != self.db:
                raise SystemExit(f"Not removing {self.work}: its marker records database {recorded or 'nothing'}, "
                                 f"not {self.db}")
            shutil.rmtree(self.work)
            say(f"removed {self.work}")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="tools/s601b_action_walkthrough.py")
    parser.add_argument("--db", required=True, help="private database, assetops_s601b*")
    parser.add_argument("--work", required=True, help="work folder var/s601b* under this repository")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("prepare")
    lk = sub.add_parser("links")
    lk.add_argument("--web-port", type=int, default=WEB_PORT)
    s = sub.add_parser("serve")
    s.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=API_PORT)
    s.add_argument("--web-port", type=int, default=WEB_PORT)
    sub.add_parser("drop")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    walk = Walk(args.db, args.work)
    if args.cmd == "prepare":
        walk.prepare()
    elif args.cmd == "links":
        walk.links(args.web_port)
            raise SystemExit("gate needs exactly one of --close / --open")
        gate(work, args.close)
        return 0
    if args.command == "settle":
        out = settle(work, args.db)
        return 0 if out["gate"].get("open") or out["gate"].get("closed_by_walkthrough") else 1
    if args.command == "late":
        late(work, args.db, args)
        return 0
    # serve
    comparison(work, args.db)
    proc = start_api(work, args.db, args.api_port)
    say(f"API for {args.db}: python -m uvicorn lab_app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port {args.api_port} "
        f"(log {work / 'logs' / f'api-{args.api_port}.log'})")
    say("Frontend, from frontend/:")
    say(f'  $env:ASSETOPS_API_PORT="{args.api_port}"; npm.cmd run dev -- --port {args.web_port} --strictPort')
    for name, url in owner_urls(args.web_port):
        say(f"  {name:18} {url}")
    say("No schedule is installed: `late`, `gate` and `settle` are explicit. Ctrl+C stops the API.")
    try:
        proc.wait()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        proc.terminate()

Receipt freshness `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` is distinct from reported-fact age/trust and `STALE_PROJECTION`. Fresh receipt of old facts may have current gateway contact and old/Unknown facts. Gateway contact never proves source-device contact. No registered gateway = `NO_REGISTERED_SOURCE`; registered never received = `UNKNOWN`. Stale receipt does not date an outage; queue/disk are last reported, not current hardware state. Store failure or inconsistent registration/diagnostic selection cannot yield a current claim. No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.
+
+Battery read resolves effective Site basis and configured asset/binding IDs. Return `UNKNOWN` physical condition with named missing accepted causal temperature/capacity/stress inputs, or `NOT_CONFIGURED`/Unknown reason if absent/unbound. SOC and nameplate may appear only under separate evidence/declared labels and exact accepted IDs. Withhold degradation, remaining life, stress score, warranty/replacement exposure and diagnosis. Enforce tenant/Site/asset 401/403/404; a foreign asset is never an empty healthy row.

+## Read and UI contract
+
+- One consistent DB snapshot selects `created_at >= from AND created_at < to` and latest event by `(recorded_at,id)`, never `occurred_at`. Order `created_at DESC, action_id ASC`; bounded page and opaque cursor bind tenant, Site, window, selection fence and last sort key.
+- Echo scope/display timezone, `read_at`, max included creation/event-recorded fence or explicit zero-row fence, total and next cursor. `CURRENT` only after successful scoped read. Zero means no persisted Actions created in this Site/window. A changed fence invalidates page 2 and requires reload from page 1. Preserve historical Action detail separately.
+- 401 unauthenticated, 403 known forbidden, 404 foreign/nonexistent Site or root. Invalid/unbounded window, changed cursor, unavailable store or inconsistent snapshot is typed refusal, never empty success. UI keeps Site/window in URL, shows count/page basis, exact FindingRevision and ActionEvent links, Unknown/error distinctly, native keyboard navigation and no invented verification result.

+# S7-01a — Central source health and asset boundary reads
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after independent review. Size M, two phases. Branch `task/S7-01a-health-read` from merged main. Depends on S2-02 central diagnostics and S1-02 effective bindings. Authority: `.agent/architect-W1-remaining-answers.md`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md` `D-2026-10-16-a-s7-health`, `D-2026-10-09-pre-s3-evidence-readiness-health`; registry `D-edge-health-cases`, `I-source-health-read`, `I-asset-boundary-read`. No UI/panel promotion in this part.
+
+## Verified seams and new contract
+
+Existing central diagnostic selection: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/adapters/postgres_gateway_access.py:172-194`; cadence contact and diagnostic fields: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/gateway_access.py:289-343`; `GET /api/sites/{site_id}/gateway-health`: `backend/assetops_backend/gateway_api.py:38,93-109`; existing client: `frontend/src/sites/gatewayHealthClient.ts:3,68`. Existing S1 basis/binding tables: `backend/migrations/versions/0001_foundation_identity.py`, `0002_signal_bindings.py`. **New:** two-clock Site source-health interpretation/read and Site/asset-scoped configured-battery boundary read/API; neither is a physical health assessment.
+
+Site read resolves registered gateway/source IDs, most recent centrally stored diagnostic per gateway, local sequence, diagnostic ID, server `received_at`, reported `observed_at`, cadence, read time, source watermark, source-specific contact time where supplied, queue depth/oldest age, clock offset/trust and disk pressure. Receipt freshness `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` is distinct from reported-fact age/trust and `STALE_PROJECTION`. Fresh receipt of old facts may have current gateway contact and old/Unknown facts. Gateway contact never proves source-device contact. No registered gateway = `NO_REGISTERED_SOURCE`; registered never received = `UNKNOWN`. Stale receipt does not date an outage; queue/disk are last reported, not current hardware state. Store failure or inconsistent registration/diagnostic selection cannot yield a current claim. No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.
+
+Battery read resolves effective Site basis and configured asset/binding IDs. Return `UNKNOWN` physical condition with named missing accepted causal temperature/capacity/stress inputs, or `NOT_CONFIGURED`/Unknown reason if absent/unbound. SOC and nameplate may appear only under separate evidence/declared labels and exact accepted IDs. Withhold degradation, remaining life, stress score, warranty/replacement exposure and diagnosis. Enforce tenant/Site/asset 401/403/404; a foreign asset is never an empty healthy row.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable and focused proof |
+| --- | --- |
+| 1. Central fixture/read | **New** `D-edge-health-cases` through registered gateway authentication and central ingestion: current heartbeat, stale cadence, delayed old diagnostic freshly received, growing queue/old item, clock offset/untrusted time, disk pressure/acquisition stop then recovery; also never received and wrong Site. Assert ID, sequence, server/reported times and reload. Add `backend/tests/test_s7_source_health_postgres.py` (new), including refusal and stale-projection cases. |
+| 2. Asset boundary/review | **New** configured battery with missing causal input, unbound/absent battery and wrong asset/Site checks in `backend/tests/test_s7_asset_boundary_postgres.py` (new). Pin basis/binding IDs after reload. If DDL is needed, allocate after main's `0018_finding_match_deferral`; S6-02a adds unmerged `0019_verification_core`, so re-chain migration at merge. Audit any new writer/fixture SQL against statement-level rule 8 and run `python tools/writer_guard_probes.py`. Run `tools/check-all.ps1`, registry checker and one final-revision full backend suite with private `*_test` DB per `backend/TESTING.md:104,112-125`: `pytest backend/tests -n 2 --dist loadfile --no-loadscope-reorder -q --junitxml=.pytest-junit.xml`, keep-awake, 20-minute cap, JUnit zero skipped/failed. Fresh independent review permits merge; S7-01b consumes this contract. |

+# S7-01a — Central source health and asset boundary reads
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after independent review. Size M, two phases. Branch `task/S7-01a-health-read` from merged main. Depends on S2-02 central diagnostics and S1-02 effective bindings. No UI/panel promotion in this part.
+
+## Verified seams and new contract
+
+Existing central diagnostic selection: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/adapters/postgres_gateway_access.py:172-194`; cadence contact and diagnostic fields: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/gateway_access.py:289-343`; `GET /api/sites/{site_id}/gateway-health`: `backend/assetops_backend/gateway_api.py:38,93-109`; existing client: `frontend/src/sites/gatewayHealthClient.ts:3,68`. +
+Site read resolves registered gateway/source IDs, most recent centrally stored diagnostic per gateway, local sequence, diagnostic ID, server `received_at`, reported `observed_at`, cadence, read time, source watermark, source-specific contact time where supplied, queue depth/oldest age, clock offset/trust and disk pressure. Receipt freshness `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` is distinct from reported-fact age/trust and `STALE_PROJECTION`. Fresh receipt of old facts may have current gateway contact and old/Unknown facts. Gateway contact never proves source-device contact. No registered gateway = `NO_REGISTERED_SOURCE`; registered never received = `UNKNOWN`. Stale receipt does not date an outage; queue/disk are last reported, not current hardware state. Store failure or inconsistent registration/diagnostic selection cannot yield a current claim. No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.
+
+Battery read resolves effective Site basis and configured asset/binding IDs. Return `UNKNOWN` physical condition with named missing accepted causal temperature/capacity/stress inputs, or `NOT_CONFIGURED`/Unknown reason if absent/unbound. SOC and nameplate may appear only under separate evidence/declared labels and exact accepted IDs. Withhold degradation, remaining life, stress score, warranty/replacement exposure and diagnosis. Enforce tenant/Site/asset 401/403/404; a foreign asset is never an empty healthy row.

+# S7-01a — Central source health and asset boundary reads
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after independent review. Size M, two phases. Branch `task/S7-01a-health-read` from merged main. No UI/panel promotion in this part.
+
+## Verified seams and new contract
+
+Existing central diagnostic selection: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/adapters/postgres_gateway_access.py:172-194`; cadence contact and diagnostic fields: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/gateway_access.py:289-343`; `GET /api/sites/{site_id}/gateway-health`: `backend/assetops_backend/gateway_api.py:38,93-109`; existing client: `frontend/src/sites/gatewayHealthClient.ts:3,68`. +
+Site read resolves registered gateway/source IDs, most recent centrally stored diagnostic per gateway, local sequence, diagnostic ID, server `received_at`, reported `observed_at`, cadence, read time, source watermark, source-specific contact time where supplied, queue depth/oldest age, clock offset/trust and disk pressure. Receipt freshness `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` is distinct from reported-fact age/trust and `STALE_PROJECTION`. Fresh receipt of old facts may have current gateway contact and old/Unknown facts. Gateway contact never proves source-device contact. No registered gateway = `NO_REGISTERED_SOURCE`; registered never received = `UNKNOWN`. Stale receipt does not date an outage; queue/disk are last reported, not current hardware state. Store failure or inconsistent registration/diagnostic selection cannot yield a current claim. No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.
+
+Battery read resolves effective Site basis and configured asset/binding IDs. Return `UNKNOWN` physical condition with named missing accepted causal temperature/capacity/stress inputs, or `NOT_CONFIGURED`/Unknown reason if absent/unbound. SOC and nameplate may appear only under separate evidence/declared labels and exact accepted IDs. Withhold degradation, remaining life, stress score, warranty/replacement exposure and diagnosis. Enforce tenant/Site/asset 401/403/404; a foreign asset is never an empty healthy row.

+Site read resolves registered gateway/source IDs, most recent centrally stored diagnostic per gateway, local sequence, diagnostic ID, server `received_at`, reported `observed_at`, cadence, read time, source watermark, source-specific contact time where supplied, queue depth/oldest age, clock offset/trust and disk pressure. Receipt freshness `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` is distinct from reported-fact age/trust and `STALE_PROJECTION`. Fresh receipt of old facts may have current gateway contact and old/Unknown facts. Gateway contact never proves source-device contact. No registered gateway = `NO_REGISTERED_SOURCE`; registered never received = `UNKNOWN`. Stale receipt does not date an outage; queue/disk are last reported, not current hardware state. Store failure or inconsistent registration/diagnostic selection cannot yield a current claim. No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.
+
+Battery read resolves effective Site basis and configured asset/binding IDs. Return `UNKNOWN` physical condition with named missing accepted causal temperature/capacity/stress inputs, or `NOT_CONFIGURED`/Unknown reason if absent/unbound. SOC and nameplate may appear only under separate evidence/declared labels and exact accepted IDs. Withhold degradation, remaining life, stress score, warranty/replacement exposure and diagnosis. Enforce tenant/Site/asset 401/403/404; a foreign asset is never an empty healthy row.

+# S3-02a — Selected assessment capability and claim-limit reads
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after independent review. Size M, two phases. Branch `task/S3-02a-capability-read` from merged main. Depends on reviewed/merged S3-01 selected assessment and accepted `I-sim-dispatch-cases`. Authority: `.agent/architect-W1-remaining-answers.md`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md` `D-2026-10-16-s302-capability`, `D-2026-10-09-pre-s3-evidence-readiness-health`; registry `I-capability-read`, `I-claim-limit-read`. This part does not promote `evidence-analysis:2#b`.

+## Verified seams and read contract
+
+Existing selected day/window status, basis, coverage, watermarks and limitations: `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/dispatch_read.py:123-166`; exact revision lineage `:178-202`; routes `backend/assetops_backend/performance_api.py:88-101`; S3 tests `backend/tests/test_s3_dispatch_read_postgres.py`, `test_s3_dispatch_assessment_postgres.py`. S2 explanation is separate in `frontend/src/sites/LedgerSiteEvidence.tsx:1115`. **New:** versioned `CapabilityReadiness` and claim-ceiling service/API for one authenticated mini-grid Site, half-open UTC day and exact selected S3 dispatch window/interval `assessment_revision_id`, using that assessment's accepted public `EvidenceQuery`/`AnalyticInputSet`. Do not select later readings or another revision.
+
+Echo tenant/Site, day/window, revision, run/model/cohort, knowledge cutoff, effective Foundation/binding IDs, accepted evidence IDs, source/analytic watermarks, `built_at` and `read_at`. Return per-required-role covered duration/quality, missing/conflicted spans, selection/rule basis and named limitations. Versioned claim-limit mapping bounds the selected dispatch classification to Candidate/Necessary/Indeterminate support; no physical capacity inferred from configured capability. Positive ceiling requires current exact S3 selection, complete relevant rule assessment and accepted public role evidence. Current assessment may still be `LIMITED` or `UNKNOWN` in portions. No assessment = `UNASSESSED`; pending/failed/dirty/changed selection = `PENDING`/`FAILED`/`STALE_PROJECTION` and no current positive claim. Prior exact revision may be read as historical only. Reject foreign Site/revision, revision outside selected window, unsupported rule version and absent accepted lineage; 401/403/404 identity boundary applies.

+## Architect questions

+## Read and UI contract
+
+- One consistent DB snapshot selects `created_at >= from AND created_at < to` and latest event by `(recorded_at,id)`, never `occurred_at`. Return row key `(tenant_id,site_id,action_id)`, code, creation time, origin Finding and FindingRevision IDs, selected event ID/recorded time, reduced lifecycle, canonical and exact-event Action links. Order `created_at DESC, action_id ASC`; bounded page and opaque cursor bind tenant, Site, window, selection fence and last sort key.
+- Echo scope/display timezone, `read_at`, max included creation/event-recorded fence or explicit zero-row fence, total and next cursor. `CURRENT` only after successful scoped read. Zero means no persisted Actions created in this Site/window. A changed fence invalidates page 2 and requires reload from page 1. Preserve historical Action detail separately.
+- 401 unauthenticated, 403 known forbidden, 404 foreign/nonexistent Site or root. Invalid/unbounded window, changed cursor, unavailable store or inconsistent snapshot is typed refusal, never empty success. UI keeps Site/window in URL, shows count/page basis, exact FindingRevision and ActionEvent links, Unknown/error distinctly, native keyboard navigation and no invented verification result.

+# S7-01a — Central source health and asset boundary reads
+
+Status: implementation-ready. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false; non-UI, mergeable after independent review. Size M, two phases. Branch `task/S7-01a-health-read` from merged main. Depends on S2-02 central diagnostics and S1-02 effective bindings. No UI/panel promotion in this part.
+
+## Verified seams and new contract
+
+Existing central diagnostic selection: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/adapters/postgres_gateway_access.py:172-194`; cadence contact and diagnostic fields: `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/gateway_access.py:289-343`; `GET /api/sites/{site_id}/gateway-health`: `backend/assetops_backend/gateway_api.py:38,93-109`; existing client: `frontend/src/sites/gatewayHealthClient.ts:3,68`. Existing S1 asset/basis/binding tables: `backend/migrations/versions/0001_foundation_identity.py:95,149`, `backend/migrations/versions/0002_signal_bindings.py:37,65`. **New:** two-clock Site source-health interpretation/read and Site/asset-scoped configured-battery boundary read/API; neither is a physical health assessment.
+
+Site read resolves registered gateway/source IDs, most recent centrally stored diagnostic per gateway, local sequence, diagnostic ID, server `received_at`, reported `observed_at`, cadence, read time, source watermark, source-specific contact time where supplied, queue depth/oldest age, clock offset/trust and disk pressure. Receipt freshness `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` is distinct from reported-fact age/trust and `STALE_PROJECTION`. Fresh receipt of old facts may have current gateway contact and old/Unknown facts. Gateway contact never proves source-device contact. No registered gateway = `NO_REGISTERED_SOURCE`; registered never received = `UNKNOWN`. Stale receipt does not date an outage; queue/disk are last reported, not current hardware state. Store failure or inconsistent registration/diagnostic selection cannot yield a current claim. No join from diagnostics to accepted measurements.
+
+Battery read resolves effective Site basis and configured asset/binding IDs. Return `UNKNOWN` physical condition with named missing accepted causal temperature/capacity/stress inputs, or `NOT_CONFIGURED`/Unknown reason if absent/unbound. SOC and nameplate may appear only under separate evidence/declared labels and exact accepted IDs. Withhold degradation, remaining life, stress score, warranty/replacement exposure and diagnosis. Enforce tenant/Site/asset 401/403/404; a foreign asset is never an empty healthy row.
